method.scope: Keep the previous 765 structural report projections separate from a bounded supplement: parse only the import-observer and fallback CLI JSON stdout cases in the eight full CLI suites. The supplement adds 16 full reports. Do not parse any other JSON stdout.
method.pairReports: Match artifact name, artifact-relative JSON path and RFC 6901 report pointer. For supplemental reports, pointer selects a stdout string; parse that string as JSON and then follow decodedPointer. baselinePointer records an explicitly renamed scenario, otherwise pointer applies to both builds.
method.deduplicate: Require result and report.result to be deeply equal, retain report.result once. Require summary.publicExamples to equal corresponding fields of public-consumer-examples.json, omit that duplicate file. Keep separately executed scenarios, repetitions and hosts.
method.outcomeChecks: Require unique identities per phase/report. Keep IDs, local IDs, verdict, countedAsKilled, pseudoTested and every other outcome field except individual executionMs and raw execution evidence. Retain every mutant setup state/count/error/selection and runner report as setupStates. Retain load-failure evidence status as evidenceState and its complete runner report as evidenceReport, except executionId and temporary path prefixes. Node load rows remain ID-only structured evidence.
method.snapshots: Keep original full-report phaseTimings, scalar phase counters/timings, enabled operators, full perOperator rows, completeness/cancellation/signal, outer quality state, setup states/jobs/timeouts/timings, and diagnostics.runnerVersions including actual runtime and observer state. Do not turn missing values or null timings into zero.
method.sourceChecks: Compare complete source arrays without normalization. Store SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and literal Unicode, plus every difference.
method.assessmentChanges: Compare all assessment fields outside source arrays and outcomes (compared separately), diagnostic text/derived scheduling diagnostics, per-run execution IDs and the explicit duration field list. Keep diagnostics.runnerVersions. Keep timeoutMs, mutantTimeoutMs and uncappedMutantTimeoutMs semantic; adaptive timeout differences are retained and checked against each run baseline.
method.temporaryIdentityHandling: Only inside runner reports, remove executionId and reduce file/path/testFiles and observer receipt entry/source paths to base names. Mask capture-<pid>-<clock>- in assessment text. Keep observer receipt file names, line/column/version, test counts, states and Node versions. Source arrays are never normalized.
method.fullReportJobArithmetic: Sum baseline/coverage/direct-typecheck jobs (one if ms exists), compilerStrictness.job (one if present), phase jobsAttempted, workerBaselineJobs and preparedBaselineJobs. Reused typecheck contributes no job. Assert both full-report totals and all perOperator count/job sums.
method.hashes: Check every artifact ZIP in both builds against GitHub digest and byte size, CRC, safe unique membership, and exact local JSON membership/bytes. Store raw JSON hashes, artifact IDs, URLs, run/head coordinates and ZIP receipts. Reuse previous comparison candidate-side baseline coordinates and all 56 compared raw JSON hashes.
method.reconstruction: outcomeSets interns baseline shared rows (candidateChanges excluded from baseline fields), removed baseline rows and added candidate rows. Baseline is shared+removed. Candidate is shared with every candidateChanges JSON-pointer operation applied, plus added. Retain setup row changes independently. Separate raw-data verification reconstructs both sides and their counters.
method.timings: Retain actual floating-point phase timings and supplied scalar timings, including nulls. They are single shared-runner samples, with no performance claim.

normalisations.sources: None. Full source arrays compare exactly.
normalisations.timeoutLimits: None. All timeout limits remain in semantic equality; 13 adaptive values differ and are retained with per-build arithmetic.

equivalentMutants.basis: Discarding the numeric literal in equivalent() and dropping terminal bare returns in terminal() and values() do not change this fixture. The functions do not reflect on source. These closed examples do not estimate equivalence elsewhere.

mixedFiles.outcome0: Both unresolved: candidate attributes one application failure but also reports one unresolved file error.
mixedFiles.outcome1: execution-error to killed: candidate reports one attributed application failure, one passing file and zero unresolved errors. The raw diagnostic retains `if ((ready))`; the unrelated file throws only for the other mutant containing !==.

scenarioMapping.evidenceChange: Replace synthetic unsupported Node 24.22.0 with removed SESHAT_LOAD_CONTEXT on the actual runtime. Both verdicts stay execution-error.
Same control change in readable output; incomplete score and execution-error stay, inactive-observer message disappears.

limits: No builds, dependency installation or new assessments were run; this compares retained CI artifacts of two direct heads.

The original scope has 765 structural report projections. The separate observer CLI supplement parses only two JSON stdout cases in each of eight 85-scenario CLI suites. Other JSON stdout, readable output beyond the stated fallback projection, and packaging/stage checks are outside this assessment comparison.

The 130 Node load-failure reports retain 210 structured outcomes per build with ID-only identity. Diagnostic source text explains mixed-files outcome 1, but does not turn the retained rows into full source-edit identities.
Statement operator rows retain phase counters rather than each mutant identity. Separate semantic facts and proof source hashes are retained for all five hosts.

Exclude raw runner diagnostic text, execution IDs, individual mutant execution durations and setup execution receipts beyond the retained status/report projections. Normalize only per-run runner-report paths/capture IDs as documented; preserve source arrays and timeout limits.
Missing partial-report metrics remain absent and null timings remain null. Reports without an outer CLI envelope have no retained quality state.

Source-error scheduling, Windows cancelled child exit codes and timing-derived timeout limits vary between retained runs. The report retains actual values and the checks explaining them; a single run cannot establish a distribution or performance change.

Artifact ZIP members and all extracted JSON bytes are verified, but build logs, package archives, the separate linux-x64-debian-stage-evidence artifact, notices and publication approval are outside this comparison.

Readable fallback projections retain their exact diagnostic lines, including eight changing individual execution durations. Those eight differences are classified readableDuration after requiring all surrounding text to match.
All timings are actual single shared-runner samples. No performance claim follows.
